item.text: [{"task_id":"95a58926","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    line = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    threshold = float(params['density'][0])","    marker = background","    best = -1","    for color in np.unique(grid):","        if color != background and color != line:","            count = np.count_nonzero(grid == color)","            if count > best:","                best = count","                marker = int(color)","    rows = [np.mean(row == line) > threshold for row in grid]","    columns = [np.mean(column == line) > threshold for column in grid.T]","    result = np.full(grid.shape, background, dtype=int)","    for r, horizontal in enumerate(rows):","        for c, vertical in enumerate(columns):","            if horizontal and vertical:","                result[r, c] = marker","            elif horizontal or vertical:","                result[r, c] = line","    return result"],"shapes":{"colors":[2],"density":[1]},"params":{"colors":[0,5],"density":[0.5]},"rationale":"Identify gray grid lines by their majority density, restore their full extent, erase scattered markers, and place the input's remaining color at every horizontal and vertical intersection.
